proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal: Report Regarding Direct and Indirect Political Contributions
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing Lilly's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model-legislation memberships, and oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the proposal.
